page: Google Cloud Platform c2d-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks reveal a strong single-core CPU capability, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance ranking in the top 25 percent at 2923.48. However, multi-core and memory-intensive operations show limitations. The stress-ng multi-core performance of 2928.18 and Geekbench multi-core score of 2021.0 are positioned in the bottom 25 percent and bottom 10 percent respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 136.13 GB/sec and a write large block speed of 24.26 GB/sec, both falling into the lower tiers of performance.

From a workload perspective, the c2d-standard-2 is suited for lightweight general-purpose tasks, single-threaded applications, and basic text processing, where its strong single-core performance can be utilized. It is less optimal for multi-threaded compilation, complex database operations, or memory-bound workloads due to its lower multi-core efficiency and memory bandwidth.
